thread:
incident-bot: P1 ALERT — region0 primary GPU pool saturation detected. queue_length > 18k, p95 latency spiking 4x. autoscaler failed to provision additional nodes (error: quota_exceeded). paging incident channel.

maria-oncall: seeing the same in Grafana. requests are piling in job-queue: redis backlog ~18,400. throwing immediate pager.

jonah-runtime: autoscaler logs show repeated rate limit from cloud provider: 'Instance launch rate limit exceeded'. we tried a scale-up at t+00:02 but cloud refused. cluster still at 120 GPUs, target 180.

sre-jen: any partial mitigation available? can we split traffic to eu1/apac or use warm standby pools?

leo-platform: we have cross-region routing enabled, but policy is: prefer region0 then eu1 then apac fallback. current routing shows almost all requests still pinned to region0 due to sticky sessions (session affinity cookie).

amanda-cs: customers reporting elevated error rates and timeouts. support queue has multiple high-priority tickets from an enterprise customer (AcmeCorp) complaining about repeated 504s.

maria-oncall: immediate plan: 1) disable session affinity for inference routes to allow spillover 2) relax routing policy to aggressively reroute to eu1 3) enable manual pool burst in eu1 if capacity exists 4) throttle low-tier requests in region0 to preserve capacity for enterprise tiers. anyone object?

jonah-runtime: ok on 1 & 2. disabling affinity now. executing: 
```
# disable affinity for /v1/generate
curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/routes/region0/disable_affinity -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\"
```

deploy-bot: deploy started for route config change (deploy_id: d-7890). no errors yet.

leo-platform: relaxing policy to allow region steering: set prefer_primary:false for inference-prod routes. applying now.

jonah-runtime: initiating eu1 burst: we have 40 available GPUs in eu1 unallocated. starting warmup of 20 gpus for immediate spillover. command: `platform scale --region eu1 --pool inference-warm --gpu 20 --reason emergency`

sre-jen: setting temporary token bucket throttle on region0 to 50% for non-enterprise keys. patching at the edge gateway: 
```
# nginx rate-limit snippet
limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=rl:10m rate=100r/s;
```

maria-oncall: note — autoscaler stuck due to cloud quota. I opened a request with cloud support (ticket 987654) but expected time to resolution unknown. manual burst in other regions is best immediate path.

amanda-cs: informing AcmeCorp support lead; giving ETA ~15-30m for routing changes to take effect.

jonah-runtime: routing changes just propagated. metrics starting to shift: region0 qps down 35%, eu1 qps up 28%. queue depth in region0 falling from 18.4k -> 11.2k in 6m. p95 latency trending down but still elevated.

incident-bot: Incident timeline recorded: start=2112223334 severity=P1 impact=high services=inference-api, routing-engine

maria-oncall: re: throttles — confirm which API keys are considered enterprise. leo?

leo-platform: enterprise keys tagged with plan:enterprise in billing DB. I'm pushing a whitelist to the gateway now.

jonah-runtime: small hiccup: one worker pool in eu1 returned model mismatch on first warm container (variant mismatch due to older quantized build). rolling patch to ensure model:stable tag used.

deploy-bot: canary rollback triggered for eu1 image (image: inference:v2026.04.2 -> v2026.04.1).

jonah-runtime: fixed. warm pool now serving accepted requests. spillover looks stable.

amanda-cs: AcmeCorp reports improved success rate in last 10m. still seeing some 504s but far fewer.

sre-jen: next action: 1) keep routing relaxed until cloud quota cleared or region0 autoscaler resumes 2) monitor queue <2k threshold for de-escalation 3) file formal postmortem and runbook updates about affinity + fallback. assign owners?

maria-oncall: assigning postmortem to jonah-runtime (lead), with sre-jen and leo-platform as reviewers. I'll own the customer impact summary. deadline EOD tomorrow.

jonah-runtime: noted. initial findings: autoscaler failed due to provider rate limit + lack of prewarmed capacity in eu1. session affinity prevented spillover. small config and runbook gaps.

maria-oncall: current status: mitigations active, customer impact reduced, monitoring continuing. keeping channel open until queue <2k and p95 latency within 1.5x baseline.

incident-bot: UPDATE: queue_length=1180, p95 latency=1.6x baseline, error_rate=0.6% (down from 6.1%).

amanda-cs: closing most customer tickets as resolved but keeping follow-ups for enterprise customers that saw retries.

maria-oncall: any follow-up items to add to the postmortem?

leo-platform: add a play to proactively prewarm standby capacity during predicted traffic spikes and add a fast path to bypass affinity for critical routes. also add quota monitoring alarms / escalations to cloud support.

jonah-runtime: will include autoscaler logs, cloud quota error strings, and the fix timeline in draft.

maria-oncall: thanks all. I'll end the pager in 30m unless things regress. great coordination. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: route config deploy d-7890 complete.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (soft) — mitigations holding. final metrics snapshot: queue_length=420, p95 latency=1.2x baseline, error_rate=0.2%.

maria-oncall: creating follow-up ticket: PM-4282 (postmortem + runbook updates). assigning to jonah-runtime.

jonah-runtime: acknowleded, will start draft now.

amanda-cs: sending summary to affected customers.

sre-jen: moving to post-incident review channel after this thread.

maria-oncall: thread archived in 2 hours for postmortem write-up.
